narr: Heavy rains in the city of Houston produced flash flooding.
ev: Fire Department preformed over 10 different water rescues across the Houston area.||TxDOT also reported flash flooding near I-45 and I-610. Areas west of I-45 from Telephone Rd to Roe Dr were indicated as flooded. TxDOT noted that water was covering the roadway along the westbound frontage road.||A Storm chaser also shared a video on social media, showing flooding at I-45 south and Wayside Drive. Significant inundation can be seen in the video with two cars stalled.
